sentences.en: Sorry about my mistakes; I'm a beginner. Corrections are welcome.
sentences.zh: 对不起我犯的错误，我是初学者。欢迎指出改正。

sentences.en: The best student is the one who accepts the correction.
sentences.zh: 最好的学生是能够接受指正的学生。

sentences.en: The last correction was made on the twenty-first of August.
sentences.zh: 最后一次订正在8月21日进行。

senses.zh: 改〔纠〕正修改；纠正有待改正
